feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
entry.summary: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: World leaders gather in New York for U.N. General Assembly, Trump says his proposed D.C. arch will be "military complex," FAA rolls out AI-enhanced software to manage nation's skies.

entry.title: Diesel -- the fuel the U.S. economy runs on -- hits record high
entry.summary: Diesel prices continue setting records, now above $6.50 a gallon. That could mean higher prices not just for truckers, but for everyone.

entry.title: How rising diesel fuel costs are affecting American farmers
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks John Boyd Jr. of the National Black Farmers Association how farmers are affected by record high diesel fuel costs.

entry.title: Hundreds vie for the chance to become the new voice of Boston's Logan Airport
entry.summary: Hundreds of people answered Boston's Logan Airport's open casting call to find an authentic local voice for announcements.

entry.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and weaponry
entry.summary: President Trump says his planned arch will also serve as a military complex as he faces pushback on his multiple construction projects in the nation's capital.

entry.title: Retired major general questions Trump's plan for a militarized monumental arch
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with retired Major General Randy Manner about President Trump's militarization plans for a monumental arch.

entry.title: FAA to launch AI-enhanced software to help manage the nation's airspace
entry.summary: Regulators at the Federal Aviation Administration are preparing to roll out AI-enhanced software in an $875 million overhaul to manage the nation's airspace.

entry.title: U.S. citizen's detention in China may be a topic of discussion during D.C. visit
entry.summary: In June, U.S. citizen and prominent Myanmar scholar Min Zin was taken into custody in China. Min Zin's detention will likely be on the agenda during Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington.

entry.title: Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas
entry.summary: The Department of Homeland Security said Monday it was leading the investigation into the officer involved in a shooting of "an illegal alien from Venezuela" during an operation in Austin, Texas.
